workarounds.note: page.dpi 144, not 150: at 150 dpi a 29 pt grid line is 60.41666… px, and the heading keep-with-next check in pipeline/build.ts (remainAfterHeading < minSpaceAfter, compared without FIT_EPS) found a head with a two-line paragraph on the last three lines of the page 1e-13 px short and pushed it to the next page, leaving three blank lines; at 2 px to the point the sums are exact

headings.balancing.enabled: false: on a character grid the loose-paragraph lever re-broke a Chinese paragraph a line longer by spreading its characters 0.13 em (balancing.maxTracking allows 0.01 em), and the heading lever adds grid lines above heads; both move text off the grid
each heading template opens with two U+3000: heading levels have no indent setting, and GB/T 9704 indents every head two cells (a head that wraps returns to the margin, as the standard wants)
